Hero.title: Concerts with Mom and Dad
Hero.subtitle: Interactive musical activity for children aged 0 to 5 years
Hero.description: Based on the teaching experience that the group members have carried out for over 15 years at nurseries and kindergartens in Rome and its province. Annamaria Diroma, Francesca Scaglione and Monserrat Olavarria Balmaceda lead the activity through voice and instruments, proposing rhythms and melodies drawn from the most varied musical repertoire. The intervention method is designed and thought out based on the real listening abilities of children and is inspired by the principles of musical learning by E.E. Gordon. During the activity children are free to interact with music through voice and movement.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.content: Concerts with Mom and Dad respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy informs you about how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our website and services.

dataCollection.title: Data We Collect
dataCollection.content: When you book a musical activity through our booking form, we collect:
items: Participating children's data (name, birth date, age)
Fiscal data (only if you request a receipt): surname, name, tax code, place and date of birth, residence, postal code, city

dataUse.title: How We Use Your Data
dataUse.content: We use your data exclusively to:
items: Send you confirmations and communications related to booked events
Comply with legal and fiscal obligations

dataStorage.title: Data Storage
dataStorage.content: Your personal data is stored securely in our Strapi database. We retain data for as long as necessary to provide our services and to comply with legal obligations (e.g., fiscal data retention for 10 years).

intro.title: What are Cookies
intro.content: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device when you visit a website. They are used to make websites work more efficiently and to provide information to site owners.

essential.title: Essential Cookies
essential.description: These cookies are necessary for the site to function:
items: Session cookies: to maintain your active session
Language preference cookies: to remember your selected language (it/en)
Consent cookies: to remember your cookie choice

functional.title: Functional Cookies
items: SessionStorage for popups: remembers if you've seen the voucher popup (session only)

noCookies.title: What We DON'T Use
items: Tracking or analytics cookies (Google Analytics, etc.)

manageCookies.title: How to Manage Cookies
manageCookies.content: You can control and/or delete cookies as you wish. You can delete all cookies already on your computer and set most browsers to prevent them from being placed. However, if you do this, you may have to manually adjust some preferences every time you visit a site and some services and features may not work.
